name: Pregnant Angel
source:
A stranger has been spiriting away women. 
Just as Noriko Mitsukura heard about this, she met with a mysterious woman 
and a mysterious ring called the "PA". 

When she took the ring in her hand, she took its true form 
and was whisked away on her own tale! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107251.html]DLsite English[/url]]
